An authentic experience in the heart of Hanoi: an exceptional Hot Pot and a unique atmosphere!
Aug 2026 • Couples
If you want to have an authentic and unforgettable gastronomic experience in Hanoi, this restaurant in the Hoan Kiem district is absolutely not to be missed! It deserves a full 5 stars for the quality of the food, the environment, and the care of the service.
The place is truly charming, characterized by an elegant and retro atmosphere that takes you back in time, perfect for enjoying a special dinner in total relaxation. The staff was fantastic: welcoming, always smiling, attentive to our every need, and ready to explain the dishes with great courtesy.
The true star of the evening was the Hot Pot: simply delicious! Flavorful broth, rich and perfectly balanced, accompanied by very fresh, top-quality ingredients to cook on the spot. A complete, comforting dish full of flavor that made the dinner even more pleasant and convivial.
Excellent price-quality ratio and a truly high level of cuisine. If you are in Hanoi, I highly recommend it!

Service with a Smile and a Table Swap Faster Than I Can Water My Lawn 🌱😎
Dec 2024 • Business
We had an excellent experience at Quan Que Restaurant in Hong Kong—finally a place truly worthy of 5 stars.

We came for good food and got even better service. The dishes were fresh, flavorful, and genuinely satisfying. The best part? The staff treated us like VIPs without the VIP attitude.

Mid-meal, we were sitting on high chairs at the balcony. The vibe was nice, but we wanted to move inside to enjoy the cozy interior instead. Without hesitation, the team cleared an indoor table for us **super quickly**—and the whole thing was done with **big smiles** and zero stress.

No sighs. No side-eye. No stopwatch. Just efficiency delivered with warmth:
✔ Clean table 
✔ Fast swap 
✔ Friendly staff 
✔ Genuine hospitality 

It’s rare these days to see service that’s both professional **and** heartfelt, but Quan Que nailed it. They didn’t just move our seats, they *moved the mood*.

If you're a future traveler reading this: come for the food, stay for the people. They’ll take care of you—with a smile.

Totally recommend. I would come back in a heartbeat, or at least faster than fake housekeepers can knock a door at midnight. 😉

Quan Que Restaurant
Jan 2025 • Solo
I had the pleasure of dining at Quan Que during my recent trip to Vietnam, and it was an experience I won't forget. Located in a charming part of town, this restaurant offers a perfect blend of traditional Vietnamese flavors and a cozy, inviting atmosphere.

The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure our every need was met without being overbearing. The restaurant itself has a rustic, authentic feel, with wooden tables, lanterns, and beautiful decor that captures the essence of Vietnamese culture.

As for the food, it was absolutely outstanding. We started with the Goi Cuon (fresh spring rolls) and Banh Xeo (Vietnamese pancakes), both of which were bursting with flavor and made with the freshest ingredients. The highlight of the meal was definitely the Pho – a warm, aromatic bowl of noodles with a rich broth that had been simmering for hours. The balance of herbs, meat, and broth was perfect!
